    Check a whole family against these same elements

    Keep the current chapter and combination fixed. Each row adds one member. Each checkbox records an independent review for that exact combination. Open a row to add evidence.

    Browse possible combinations by number

    Pin your current TOK selection. Choose the families and how many more distinct elements to add. Each number opens one possible combination for review in the selected chapter.

    Leave empty to include all eligible families. Use Ctrl or Command to select several.

    Saved reviews

    Each board has its own 24 cells. Checks stay with the exact combination, chapter and order you reviewed.

    Take your checklist with you

    Edits are saved in this browser when storage is available. Export JSON to continue on another device or send a copy to a reviewer. CSV includes every cell on your saved boards.

    Bring back an edited Excel chapter

    Save one chapter sheet as CSV UTF-8, with its headings. The preview identifies its chapter and any changes to existing reviews. Empty cells preserve earlier work.
